using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Network;
using OpenRA.Server;
using OpenRA.Support;
using Xunit;
using S = OpenRA.Server.Server;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Server.Tests
{
	public class MasterServerPingerTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public void UpdateMasterServer_CreatesHttpClientAndPostsData()
		{
			// Arrange
			var serverMock = new Mock<S>();
			var modDataMock = new Mock<OpenRA.ModData>();
			var webServicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			webServicesMock.Setup(ws => ws.ServerAdvertise).Returns("https://test-endpoint.com");
			modDataMock.Setup(md => md.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(webServicesMock.Object);
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.ModData).Returns(modDataMock.Object);

			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();
			var postData = "test-post-data";

			// Act
			pINGER.UpdateMasterServer(serverMock.Object, postData);

			// Assert - verify the async task completes and HttpClient was used
			Thread.Sleep(100); // Allow Task.Run to execute

			// Since HttpClientFactory.Create() is static and non-virtual, we can't mock the PostAsync directly
			// but we verify the method was called by checking side effects (isBusy reset)
			Assert.False(pinger.isBusy);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void UpdateMasterServer_HandlesException_LogsError()
		{
			// Arrange - This tests the try-catch block around the PostAsync call
			var serverMock = new Mock<S>();
			var modDataMock = new Mock<OpenRA.ModData>();
			var webServicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			webServicesMock.Setup(ws => ws.ServerAdvertise).Returns("https://invalid-endpoint");
			modDataMock.Setup(md => md.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(webServicesMock.Object);
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.ModData).Returns(modDataMock.Object);

			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();
			var postData = "test-data";

			// Act
			pINGER.UpdateMasterServer(serverMock.Object, postData);

			// Assert - exception handling path taken, isBusy reset
			Thread.Sleep(200);
			Assert.False(pinger.isBusy);
			Assert.True(((Queue<string>)typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("masterServerMessages", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(pinger)).Count > 0);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void UpdateMasterServer_InitialPing_ProcessesResponseCorrectly()
		{
			// Arrange
			var serverMock = new Mock<S>();
			var modDataMock = new Mock<OpenRA.ModData>();
			var webServicesMock = new Mock<WebServices>();
			webServicesMock.Setup(ws => ws.ServerAdvertise).Returns("https://test-endpoint.com");
			modDataMock.Setup(md => md.GetOrCreate<WebServices>()).Returns(webServicesMock.Object);
			serverMock.Setup(s => s.ModData).Returns(modDataMock.Object);

			var pinger = new MasterServerPinger();
			typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("isInitialPing", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(pinger, true);
			var postData = "test-data";

			// Act
			pINGER.UpdateMasterServer(serverMock.Object, postData);

			// Assert - initial ping response processing
			Thread.Sleep(100);
			Assert.False((bool)typeof(MasterServerPinger).GetField("isInitialPing", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(pinger));
		}
	}
}
